backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the ProFi Mine backend, defining persistent data types (UserProfile, MiningProject, SubscriptionTier) and state maps, with helpers for logging, annual counter resets, and access control via mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming that the 'PDF Exports' list item was removed from the pre-login page UI, with high confidence, referencing LoginPage.tsx and test ID REQ-2.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of all frontend source files, describing each component's purpose and notable recent changes.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, covering background, foreground, chart colors, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the ProFi Mine app, mounting the React app at the #root div and loading the main.tsx module entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with routes for login (/), dashboard, payment-success, and payment-failure pages under a shared RootComponent layout.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing loading, login, and logout states with appropriate icons.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for new users to enter their name, email, organization, and choose a Free or Premium subscription tier, then save the profile via the backend mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/charts/CostBreak: Pie chart component that visualizes total mining, processing, G&A, royalties, and closure costs from project calculations, with an individual chart image export button excluded from the captured area.
frontend/src/components/charts/Cumulativ: Renders a line chart of cumulative free cash flow over project years using Recharts, with a download button that exports only the chart area as an image.
frontend/src/components/charts/Productio: Renders a bar chart of annual recovered metal production (in kg) using Recharts, with a download button that exports only the chart area as an image.
frontend/src/components/common/InfoToolt: A small reusable help icon button that displays a tooltip with explanatory text when hovered.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Dashbo: Sticky dashboard header showing the app logo, project name, subscription tier, ROM tonnage edit usage, and remaining exports, with a button to open the subscription modal.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportTab: Export tab UI that allows users to download financial projections as a CSV file, with free-tier export limit warnings and disabled state when exports are exhausted.
frontend/src/components/guide/Glossary.t: Searchable accordion glossary component that filters and displays term definitions from the GLOSSARY constants.
frontend/src/components/guide/UsageGuide: Usage guide tab with a sticky table of contents sidebar and main content area rendering guide sections from constants plus the Glossary component.
frontend/src/components/inputs/CostStruc: Form section for entering mine cost structure inputs (CAPEX, mining, processing, G&A costs, royalties, etc.) with labeled fields, tooltips, and depreciation method selection.
frontend/src/components/inputs/DynamicAr: A reusable input component that renders a dynamic list of numeric values with add/remove controls, displaying each entry in a labeled grid with a unit suffix.
frontend/src/components/inputs/EconomicP: Form section for entering economic parameters (inflation, discount, tax rates) and a per-year commodity price forecast using DynamicArrayInput, connected to ProjectContext.
frontend/src/components/inputs/Financing: Form section for entering financing parameters (equity ratio and interest rate), connected to ProjectContext with tooltip labels.
frontend/src/components/inputs/InputsTab: Composes all input sections (Reserves, Economic, Cost, Financing) into a single card-based tab view for project parameter entry.
frontend/src/components/inputs/ReservesP: Form section for reserves and production inputs (ore reserves, grade, recovery rate, stripping ratio, ROM tonnage schedule) with free-tier ROM usage gating and a subscription upgrade modal.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Root layout component that wraps the app in a ThemeProvider, renders the router Outlet, a Toaster, and a footer with branding.
frontend/src/components/layout/RootCompo: Top-level component that renders AppLayout and conditionally shows a ProfileSetupModal when an authenticated user has no profile yet.
frontend/src/components/payment/PaymentF: Page displayed after a failed payment, listing common failure reasons and providing buttons to retry or contact support.
frontend/src/components/payment/PaymentS: Page displayed after a successful payment that automatically calls the markUserAsPremium mutation and shows loading, success, or error states with appropriate UI and retry logic.
frontend/src/components/project/ProjectL: Modal dialog that lists saved projects with load and delete actions, using React Query hooks and confirmation dialogs for destructive operations.
frontend/src/components/project/SaveProj: Modal dialog for saving a mining project by name, with usage/subscription limit checks that trigger an upgrade modal if the user has reached their monthly model limit.
frontend/src/components/projections/Cash: Renders a scrollable table showing yearly cash flow data (OCF, CAPEX, closure costs, FCF, cumulative FCF) from project calculations.
frontend/src/components/projections/Inco: Renders a scrollable table displaying annual income statement rows (Revenue, OPEX, Royalties, EBITDA, Taxes, Net Income) from project calculations.
frontend/src/components/projections/Proj: Composes the full Projections tab by combining KPI summary, charts (cumulative cash flow, production, cost breakdown), income statement, and cash flow statement cards.
frontend/src/components/projections/Summ: Displays a simple two-column table of key financial KPIs (NPV, IRR, ROI, LOM, avg EBITDA, payback period) derived from project calculations.
frontend/src/components/sensitivity/Scen: Shows a comparison table of NPV, IRR, ROI, and LOM across base, optimistic, and pessimistic scenarios, with edit buttons that open the ScenarioEditor dialog.
Dialog for editing percentage adjustments (commodity price, ore grade, recovery rate, CAPEX, OPEX) for a given scenario (base, optimistic, or pessimistic).
frontend/src/components/sensitivity/Sens: Renders sliders for adjusting five key mining variables (commodity price, ore grade, recovery rate, CAPEX, OPEX) within ±20% and displays adjusted NPV, IRR, and ROI results using the SensitivityContext.
Composes the full Sensitivity Analysis tab by combining SensitivityControls, SensitivityTornado, and ScenarioComparison components inside styled cards.
Renders a horizontal tornado bar chart using Recharts showing the NPV impact of ±20% variation in key variables, sourced from SensitivityContext's tornadoData.
frontend/src/components/subscription/Sub: Displays a subscription modal showing current usage, Free and Premium tier feature cards, and a Stripe checkout upgrade button with loading and error handling.
frontend/src/config/stripe.ts: Exports the Stripe publishable key constant for use in frontend payment flows.
frontend/src/constants/glossary.ts: Exports a record mapping mining and financial term keys to their plain-English definitions for use in tooltips or help text throughout the app.
frontend/src/constants/guideContent.ts: Exports structured guide content with HTML sections covering application overview, getting started steps, input parameter explanations, and financial calculation formulas.
frontend/src/contexts/ProjectContext.tsx: Provides a React context managing project inputs, financial calculations, save/load operations, and subscription tier/usage data fetched from the user profile backend.
frontend/src/contexts/ScenarioContext.ts: Provides a React context for managing three financial scenarios (base, optimistic, pessimistic) by applying percentage adjustments to project inputs and recalculating NPV, IRR, ROI, and LOM. Wraps children with SensitivityProvider.
frontend/src/contexts/SensitivityContext: Provides a React context for sensitivity analysis, computing adjusted financial results based on user-defined parameter changes and generating tornado chart data by varying each input ±20%.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useChartExport.ts: Custom hook that exports a chart's SVG element to a PNG file by cloning the SVG, inlining computed styles, rendering to a 2x-resolution canvas, and triggering a download.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCheckoutSess: Custom hook that uses React Query's useMutation to call the backend's createPremiumCheckoutSession, parse the returned Stripe session, and redirect the user to the checkout URL.
frontend/src/hooks/useExcelExport.ts: Custom hook that generates and downloads a CSV financial report (summary KPIs, assumptions, production schedule, income statement) after verifying and decrementing the user's export quota via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication provider and hook using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing identity state, login/clear functions, and status flags for use throughout the app.
frontend/src/hooks/usePdfExport.ts: Custom hook that handles PDF export by checking export eligibility via the actor, decrementing the export count, and triggering the browser print dialog after ensuring the DOM is fully rendered.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including user profiles, mining projects, and Stripe configuration, using the ICP actor for all API calls.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind, defines mining-themed OKLCH CSS custom properties for light and dark modes, and includes print media query styles for PDF export.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Main dashboard page that renders a five-tab layout (Inputs, Projections, Sensitivity, Export, Guide) wrapped in ProjectProvider and ScenarioProvider, redirecting unauthenticated users to the login page.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page displaying the app branding, a feature list, and an Internet Identity login button, redirecting already-authenticated users to the dashboard.
frontend/src/types/external.d.ts: Empty TypeScript declaration file reserved for external module type augmentations.
frontend/src/utils/calculations.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for project inputs and financial outputs, and implements core financial calculation logic including yearly cash flows, NPV, IRR, ROI, and payback period.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Utility functions for formatting numbers as USD currency, percentages, locale-aware numbers, and dates from nanosecond BigInt timestamps.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file recording existing features, two pending action requests (fix Stripe price from $9.95 to $235, remove 'PDF Exports' UI item), and known issues.
